items.html: And from those nine white ones and nine strands of hair of the head of Arich Anpin, drawn by way of the face to the beard of ZA, are made, by the power of their illumination, only nine Tikunim in the beard of ZA, as mentioned in Idra de Nasso, page 139. But afterwards, when also those four white ones and four strands of hair of the head of Arich Anpin of the back side are drawn through the back of the head of ZA, illumination is drawn from there to the beard of ZA, and all the thirteen Tikunim of the beard are completed in him, as is explained by us in the explanation of the intention of Va'yaavor and the thirteen attributes. And see there.
